column1: #   !prompt              setup. Waits for ENTER. Untimed, not traced.
#   <seconds>TABprompt   a traced window. Do NOT touch the terminal during it;
#                        the prompt is spoken and there is a beep at each end.
# Step 1 is a liveness check, not data: moving the pointer over the phone view
# is known to make Device Hub send AbsolutePointer reports. If that window is
# empty the taps did not bind and every negative in the run is void.
# Steps 4 and 5 are the whole point: the same scroll gesture with the pointer
# resting on the list, then with the pointer outside the view. They are timed
# precisely because pressing ENTER would move the pointer and destroy the
!Unlock the phone and leave it on the Home screen
!Bring Device Hub to the front with the phone screen visible, then take your hands off

column2: LIVENESS: move the mouse slowly back and forth over the phone view
Press Command-L to lock the screen

column1: !Unlock the phone again -- take your time, then get Device Hub back in front
!Open Settings on the phone and scroll to the middle of a long list

column2: Put the pointer on the list, then two-finger scroll down twice, keeping the pointer on the list
Move the pointer far outside the phone view, then two-finger scroll down twice
